destination_translations.headline: Vallenato a orillas del Guatapurí
destination_translations.intro: Conoce la ciudad a través de su música, el centro histórico y los paisajes de los ríos Guatapurí y Badillo.
destination_translations.meta_description: Conoce el Guatapurí, la plaza Alfonso López, el Museo del Acordeón y La Mina. Descubre recorridos culturales y parrandas vallenatas en Valledupar.

destination_translations.headline: Vallenato on the banks of the Guatapurí
destination_translations.intro: Discover the city through its music, historic centre and the landscapes of the Guatapurí and Badillo rivers.
destination_translations.meta_description: Explore the Guatapurí, Alfonso López Square, the Accordion Museum and La Mina. Discover cultural tours and live vallenato gatherings in Valledupar.

destination_translations.headline: Vallenato às margens do Guatapurí
destination_translations.intro: Conheça a cidade por sua música, pelo centro histórico e pelas paisagens dos rios Guatapurí e Badillo.
destination_translations.meta_description: Conheça o Guatapurí, a praça Alfonso López, o Museu do Acordeão e La Mina. Descubra passeios culturais e parrandas vallenatas em Valledupar.

destination_story_translations.body: La vida cultural de Valledupar está ligada a los cantos y relatos del vallenato. El acordeón, la caja y la guacharaca acompañan una tradición que se escucha en parrandas, encuentros y celebraciones.
Valledupar’s cultural life is closely tied to the songs and stories of vallenato. Accordion, caja drum and guacharaca accompany a tradition heard at musical gatherings and celebrations.
A vida cultural de Valledupar está ligada aos cantos e às histórias do vallenato. Acordeão, caja e guacharaca acompanham uma tradição presente em encontros musicais e celebrações.
La plaza Alfonso López, los museos y el Guatapurí permiten recorrer distintas facetas de la ciudad. En 2019 Valledupar ingresó en la Red de Ciudades Creativas de la UNESCO en la categoría de Música.
Alfonso López Square, the museums and the Guatapurí reveal different sides of the city. In 2019 Valledupar joined the UNESCO Creative Cities Network in the field of Music.
A praça Alfonso López, os museus e o Guatapurí mostram diferentes facetas da cidade. Em 2019 Valledupar entrou na Rede de Cidades Criativas da UNESCO na categoria Música.

destination_reason_translations.body: Descubrir los paisajes del Guatapurí y el Badillo
See the landscapes of the Guatapurí and Badillo
Descobrir as paisagens do Guatapurí e do Badillo

point_of_interest_translations.name: Río Guatapurí y balneario Hurtado
point_of_interest_translations.description: Paisaje de río y grandes rocas junto a la ciudad. Consulta las condiciones de acceso tras las intervenciones del sector Hurtado.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Guatapurí River and Hurtado
point_of_interest_translations.description: River scenery and large rocks beside the city. Check access conditions following interventions in the Hurtado area.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Rio Guatapurí e balneário Hurtado
point_of_interest_translations.description: Paisagem de rio e grandes pedras junto à cidade. Consulte as condições de acesso após as intervenções no setor Hurtado.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Plaza Alfonso López y centro histórico
point_of_interest_translations.description: Árboles, calles tradicionales y edificios históricos en uno de los espacios centrales de la memoria vallenata.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Alfonso López Square and historic centre
point_of_interest_translations.description: Trees, traditional streets and historic buildings in one of the central settings of vallenato heritage.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Praça Alfonso López e centro histórico
point_of_interest_translations.description: Árvores, ruas tradicionais e construções históricas em um dos espaços centrais da memória vallenata.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Museo del Acordeón
point_of_interest_translations.description: Una colección dedicada al instrumento y a la historia del vallenato, con visitas coordinadas por el museo.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Accordion Museum
point_of_interest_translations.description: A collection devoted to the instrument and the history of vallenato, with visits arranged through the museum.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Museu do Acordeão
point_of_interest_translations.description: Uma coleção dedicada ao instrumento e à história do vallenato, com visitas organizadas pelo museu.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Parque de la Provincia
point_of_interest_translations.description: Un espacio junto al Guatapurí con esculturas dedicadas a figuras de la música vallenata y zonas para pasear.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Parque de la Provincia
point_of_interest_translations.description: A park beside the Guatapurí with sculptures honouring vallenato musicians and spaces for a stroll.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Parque de la Provincia
point_of_interest_translations.description: Um parque junto ao Guatapurí com esculturas em homenagem a figuras da música vallenata e áreas para passear.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Balneario La Mina (alrededores)
point_of_interest_translations.description: En el entorno rural de Valledupar, el río Badillo forma un paisaje de grandes rocas y pozas naturales.

point_of_interest_translations.name: La Mina river pools (surrounding area)
point_of_interest_translations.description: In Valledupar’s rural surroundings, the Badillo River flows among large rocks and natural pools.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Balneário La Mina (arredores)
point_of_interest_translations.description: Na área rural de Valledupar, o rio Badillo forma uma paisagem de grandes pedras e piscinas naturais.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Parque de la Leyenda Vallenata
point_of_interest_translations.description: El escenario Consuelo Araujonoguera es uno de los referentes del Festival de la Leyenda Vallenata. Revisa la programación y las condiciones de ingreso: no se presenta como un parque de acceso libre permanente.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Parque de la Leyenda Vallenata
point_of_interest_translations.description: The Consuelo Araujonoguera venue is a landmark of the Festival de la Leyenda Vallenata. Check its programme and entry conditions; it is not presented as a park with unrestricted year-round access.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Parque de la Leyenda Vallenata
point_of_interest_translations.description: O espaço Consuelo Araujonoguera é uma referência do Festival de la Leyenda Vallenata. Consulte a programação e as condições de entrada; não se trata de um parque com acesso livre permanente.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Callejones de la Purrututú y Mahoma
point_of_interest_translations.description: Dos callejones del centro histórico que conservan parte de la memoria del Viejo Valledupar. Se reúnen en una sola visita para caminar entre trazados y construcciones tradicionales.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Purrututú and Mahoma alleys
point_of_interest_translations.description: Two historic-centre alleys preserving part of old Valledupar’s memory. They form one walking visit through traditional streets and buildings.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Vielas da Purrututú e Mahoma
point_of_interest_translations.description: Duas vielas do centro histórico que preservam parte da memória da antiga Valledupar. Reúnem-se em uma visita a pé por traçados e construções tradicionais.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Recorrido cultural vallenato
point_of_interest_translations.description: Un recorrido guiado por la ciudad para conocer los relatos, monumentos y escenarios vinculados con el vallenato.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Vallenato cultural tour
point_of_interest_translations.description: A guided city tour exploring the stories, monuments and settings connected with vallenato.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Passeio cultural vallenato
point_of_interest_translations.description: Um passeio guiado pela cidade para conhecer histórias, monumentos e locais ligados ao vallenato.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Parranda vallenata
point_of_interest_translations.description: Un encuentro musical organizado para escuchar de cerca el acordeón, la caja y la guacharaca y conocer esta tradición.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Live vallenato gathering
point_of_interest_translations.description: An organised musical gathering to hear accordion, caja drum and guacharaca up close and learn about the tradition.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Parranda vallenata
point_of_interest_translations.description: Um encontro musical organizado para ouvir de perto acordeão, caja e guacharaca e conhecer essa tradição.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Naturaleza en Los Besotes (alrededores)
point_of_interest_translations.description: Una salida organizada a la reserva para recorrer su bosque y conocer la naturaleza de las estribaciones de la Sierra Nevada.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Nature at Los Besotes (surrounding area)
point_of_interest_translations.description: An organised visit to the reserve to explore its woodland and the natural setting of the Sierra Nevada foothills.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Natureza em Los Besotes (arredores)
point_of_interest_translations.description: Uma saída organizada à reserva para percorrer sua mata e conhecer a natureza ao pé da Sierra Nevada.
